environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary; scripted peer emitting exact response bytes, hexdump of client output

findings.description: upleft is set from the interim Content-Length and then used to bound the forwarded bytes, so the following real head is truncated at that count while the client is told the longer length. Same effect as 8d5ff1f2 with a stated length that does not match what is forwarded. Precondition: an attacker-influenced upstream.
findings.title: The interim Content-Length is stored as the remaining upstream body length and truncates the real head

limitations: All RCE is on the upstream host
methods: Read the release source from the tag
Diffed the release source against the staged copy (identical)
Control response first on the same config
Scripted peer emitted one interim shape per path
Captured client bytes as hex and diffed against the control
Sent a follow-up request on the same connection
